title: Learning to Interact in Multi-Agent Self-Play for Controllable Autonomous Driving Scenario Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.24876v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large-scale, multi-agent self-play trains robust driving policies effectively in simulation, but controlling these models to generate specific, safety-critical edge cases remains a key challenge. Existing goal-conditioned self-play frameworks rely primarily on static map-location goals and fail to reliably produce complex agent interactions such as aggressive tailgating or adversarial cut-offs. These agent interactions are necessary for rigorous autonomous vehicle (AV) testing. To address this, we present an extended multi-agent self-play framework that introduces agent-relative dynamic goals. By conditioning policies on this extended goal representation, our framework enables targeted, controllable scenario synthesis. We demonstrate that our approach successfully generates interactive driving behaviors that static-goal baselines cannot simulate, providing a flexible tool for long-tail scenario generation in AV testing.

translated_title: 面向可控自动驾驶场景生成的多智能体自博弈交互学习
translated_abstract: 大规模多智能体自博弈能够在仿真中有效训练鲁棒的驾驶策略，但如何控制这些模型生成特定的、安全攸关的边缘场景仍是一个关键挑战。现有的目标条件自博弈框架主要依赖静态的地图位置目标，无法可靠地产生复杂的智能体交互行为，例如攻击性尾随或对抗性切入，而这些交互行为对于严格的自动驾驶车辆（AV）测试是必不可少的。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一个扩展的多智能体自博弈框架，引入了智能体相对的动态目标。通过让策略以这种扩展的目标表示为条件，我们的框架能够实现有针对性的、可控的场景合成。我们证明了所提方法能够成功生成静态目标基线无法模拟的交互式驾驶行为，为自动驾驶测试中的长尾场景生成提供了灵活的工具。
tldr: 该论文提出引入智能体相对动态目标的扩展多智能体自博弈框架，实现了对攻击性尾随、对抗性切入等安全关键交互驾驶场景的精准可控生成，解决了静态目标方法无法模拟复杂智能体交互的问题。
